title: Address-reuse regression check silently skips
claim: The allocator-dependent address-reuse test skipped 7 of 20 race-stress invocations, so green runs frequently do not assert stale-address safety.

title: Finish blocking assertion can pass before Finish runs
claim: The test selects default immediately after starting Finish, without an event proving Finish reached its lifecycle-lock acquisition, so scheduling can make the assertion pass vacuously.

title: Binding-kind replacement and reader-budget transitions are untested
claim: Coverage leaves existing-pointer replacement and reader-count accounting branches unhit, including URL-to-reader rejection at capacity and reader-to-URL release.
